integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof by cut-count variance identity, constructive finite-cut realization, and equality rigidity; finite exact checker is supplementary. Independently validated: no.
scientific_limitations: Equal block sizes n>=2, number of blocks r>=2, real two-level metrics t in [1,2]; not unequal blocks, varying within-block distances, arbitrary weighted graphs, or least embedding dimension. Bibliographic priority is qualified.
title: Sharp \(\ell_1\) snowflake threshold and cut rigidity for equal-block multipartite metrics
